theorem.name: Lossless Prefix Pareto Dynamic Program
assumptions: one option is selected from each independent state group
resident-capacity usage is included in the compared objective state and feasibility is monotone under smaller resident use
safety eligibility is local and frozen before/at expansion
semantic-distinct exact ties are retained separately
theorem.statement: At every prefix depth, dominated prefixes can be discarded without changing the final distinct Pareto objective-vector frontier. Exact same-semantic objective ties may be quotient-canonicalized with provenance. Repeating this without beam truncation yields the same distinct exact frontier as B434 Cartesian enumeration.

timing_reference_3reps.note: environment-dependent reference only; state-count/exactness is the primary result

important_negative_result: The fixed mixed scenario receives only modest state-count reduction because its prefix frontier remains broad and the five-option cadence group is last, producing 400 expansions at the final depth.
